## Architecture Gate
Canonical [Sedrava declaration](https://github.com/VasiliiBabkin/sedrava/blob/main/docs/DECLARATION.ru.md).

- [ ] Read the declaration and named the application need.
- [ ] Before/after example or measured infrastructure improvement included.
- [ ] No unnecessary duplicate schema or application coordination.
- [ ] Integrity, failure/recovery, compatibility and relevant negative tests reviewed.
- [ ] Actual results, limitations and justified exceptions documented.
